model: saved per-company Mahalanobis; 2 selected features / 33-feature contract

measurement.warmup: one plaintext + one fresh HE run per company, excluded
measurement.plaintext_pipeline: scope check, read/validate saved model, snapshot features, preprocessing, score
measurement.he_pipeline: HEWorkbench.submit to decrypted durable result; includes signed readiness, model/features, encryption, checkpoints, worker HTTP and polling
measurement.excluded: worker/node startup for normal timing, offline fit, Portal/browser and public-cloud network
measurement.timing_order: alternating plaintext first and HE first; each HE run uses a fresh request, never cache
measurement.recovery_start: restart of worker/node begins; includes worker process startup; reports observed time to terminal separately
measurement.controlled_restart: Jobs.close drains native compute before restarting node/worker; prior Portal acceptance separately exercises actual UI stop

limitations: Five synthetic transactions per company; not fraud detection accuracy.
Top-5 covers all five rows and cannot demonstrate candidate-selection benefit.
Small sample recovery fractions are observations, not an SLA or a population reliability estimate.
Local loopback timings do not predict public-cloud latency; p95 is descriptive with only five default trials.
Hard crash before ciphertext commit is currently expected to fail WORKER_INTERRUPTED; reported as a failed recovery, not a success.
